investigation_notes.Description: The decoded PowerShell appears to be a downloader that sets a remote HTTP URL, writes a payload to C:\Users\Public\updater.exe, and attempts to download and execute it. VirusTotal lookup for the initiating process SHA256 returned 0 detections, and the AbuseIPDB reputation check for 183.56.231.216 failed with a server error so no score was obtained. A scheduled task was created and the script was placed in C:\Windows\Temp before being executed by SYSTEM from svchost.exe, indicating persistence/elevation and anomalous behavior, so this is classified as high priority.
investigation_notes.Inferred Script Intent: Downloader: download payload from remote HTTP URL to C:\Users\Public\updater.exe and execute it.
